title: Transition sound effects
description: Sound-design one-shots shaped to an exact duration so they line up with a cut: whoosh, riser, impact, swell, reverse cymbal and soft UI click, with brightness, pitch, stereo motion and reverb controls.

kind.description: Effect type. Risers, swells and reverse cymbals peak at the end (place them before a cut); impacts and clicks hit at the start (place them on the cut)

brightness.description: Spectral brightness of noise and tone layers

stereo_motion.description: How far the sound moves or spreads across the stereo field

reverb.description: Space around the effect (pre-verb for build-ups so they land on the cut)

notes: Effects of 0.4 s or more are normalised to -18 LUFS (peak <= -1 dBFS); shorter ones to -3 dBFS peak.
No samples: every layer is synthesized.
